mapper.insert: insert into user_bill (user_id, category_id, amount, type, create_time, remark) values (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select user_bill.*,category.name as categoryName from user_bill left join category on user_bill.category_id = category.id where user_bill.user_id = #{userId} and user_bill.id = #{billId}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cost FROM user_bill WHERE user_id = #{id} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time) ASC;
mapper.update: update user_bill set category_id = #{categoryId} where id in #{billId}
mapper.select: select id from user_bill where category_id in #{category}
